title: 完本感言（祝大家元旦快乐！）
content_zh:
完本感言（祝大家元旦快乐！）
历经三年的连载，这本书终于到了大结局，忽觉如释重负，轻快无比，却又有些怅然若失。
接下来会有一些后记陆陆续续发出来。
三年下来，前两年基本是日更万字，只有最近一年，更新才稍微少了一些，但还一年下来也写了二百四十多万字吧。
其实，到了大后期，创作最大的敌人就是自己，一方面是随着读者的阈值越来越高，一方面是作者越来越疲惫，活儿越来越难整。
甚至有时候，大脑过于疲惫，遣词造句都有重复丶赘余之弊，错漏之尴尬（我后面也会进行精修），乃至剧情构思更是不能求难，因为脑子太累了，它开始拒绝一切太过复杂的思考。
犹如长期疲劳驾驶的大货司机，犯困之时盲开一段儿，撞在了高速公路的护栏上。
长期高强度更新和高强度思考剧情，那种心理上的疲惫和步履沉重，是难以想像的。
在创作的前期丶中期丶后期，可以凭藉极大的创作热情和坚定的意志丶乃至稿费的刺激克服，但在创作的最后期，犹如一场马拉松的冲刺阶段，需要的是钢铁般的意志和一些善始善终的责任感。
事实上，我也从来没有想过拖着不完结，到后面两个月，更新乏力，直接在心理上抗拒码字，断更后稿费断崖式下跌，也视之平常，所以，也不存在水文恰烂钱的可能性。
不管这两个月如何磕磕绊绊，幸在终于写完了，整体给自己打个八十五分吧。
作为一个资深后宫老读者，我觉得我如果是读者，应该是特别喜欢我这本书的，属于能二刷三刷的那种。
八个字评价，活色生香，权色撩人……在主线维持高强度爽点的前提下，基本把每一个女主都照顾到了，情丶色丶欲皆有涉及，面面俱到。
嗯，至于文笔，那就是基操勿 6。
好了，不自吹自擂了。
当然也有一些不足和瑕疵，这些我都知道，下本书会努力改进。
正文部分基本大结局，主线的戛然而止不仅仅是留白，也是为了避免拖沓，想用后记的形式给大家交代更感兴趣的后宫诸妃丶诸藩以及夏朝的情况。
这样，我也没有更新的压力，写出来的东西更从容。
关于新书，心头有了一些想法，但因为是都市题材，我自己不确定该写不该写，或者是不是继续深耕历史。
其实，是想给自己换换脑子的，有些想写写金钱都市里的爱恨情仇，写写资本主义时代下的爱情，写写痴男怨女的挣扎浮沉，写写人性的复杂多变，写写人生的悲喜交集……

当然，嗯，依然是后宫。
相对而言，这种都市题材似乎更有表达欲一些。
是故，新书还在斟酌。
最后，就是感谢大家的一路陪伴，这三年来，一千多个日日夜夜，陪我一路写完了这本书，见证了成绩的起起伏伏，见证了每一个高潮，每一次爆更，每一篇单章……每一个令你觉得拍案叫绝的高潮章节，都是作者情绪和心血的注入，每一次让你酣畅淋漓的爆更，都是作者从早到晚的键盘敲击，每一篇让你觉得作者破防的单章，都是作者被人误解和指责后的委屈和愤怒。
真的，键盘都敲碎几个了，换上的机械键盘，空格键也被我敲出了一个凹槽，而手指一度腱鞘炎……
哈哈，不诉苦了，谁都不容易。
事实上，因为个人性格的强硬和创作者的固执，也让一些读者中途离开，我虽有遗憾，但也…不悔。
人生如写书，人来人往，相伴一程，已是一段缘分，缘分有深有浅，有人中途下车，头也不回，有人一路相伴，完整体验一段梦幻般的旅程。
不管缘分或深或浅，都不可强求，如果能在忙碌的生活里，曾经给大家带来一段简单快乐的时光，已是我等网络作家存在的最大价值。
在一一看无一错版本！
渡尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇。
我知道，骂归骂，有的嘴臭的读者还是爱看我书的，被禁言五十年后还是要看，哪怕是…白嫖（手动狗头）。
最后，祝大家元旦快乐。
祝大家在新的一年里，阖家团圆，平安喜乐，财源广进，万事如意！
由衷感谢我的盟主们还有可爱可敬的读者们，有你们的存在，才有网络文学蓬勃发展的今天。
最后的最后，再厚颜求一次月票，哈哈，双倍月票，大家投给我吧。
content_en:
Remarks at the end of this book (Happy New Year to everyone!)
After three years of serialization, this book has finally reached its finale. I suddenly feel relieved, extremely light, but also a little disappointed.
There will be some postscripts coming out one after another.
Over the past three years, the first two years have basically been about 10,000 words per day. Only in the last year have there been slightly fewer updates, but I still wrote more than 2.4 million words in one year.
In fact, in the later stages of development, the biggest enemy of creation is oneself. On the one hand, as the readers' threshold becomes higher and higher, on the other hand, the author becomes more and more tired, and the work becomes more and more difficult to complete.
Sometimes, the brain is too tired, and words and sentences are repetitive and redundant, and the mistakes and omissions are embarrassing (I will also refine it later). Even the plot conception cannot be difficult, because the brain is too tired, and it begins to reject all overly complicated thinking.
It's like a truck driver who has been driving tired for a long time. When he was sleepy, he drove blindly for a while and crashed into the guardrail of the highway.
The psychological exhaustion and heaviness of long-term high-intensity updating and intense thinking about the plot are unimaginable.
In the early, middle and late stages of creation, you can overcome them with great creative enthusiasm and firm will, and even the stimulation of royalties. But in the final stage of creation, it is like the sprint stage of a marathon. What is needed is a steely will and some sense of responsibility to start well and end well.
In fact, I never thought about procrastinating and not finishing it. In the next two months, the updates were weak, and I directly resisted coding mentally. After the update was stopped, the manuscript fee plummeted, and I regarded it as normal. Therefore, there is no possibility that the writing will be bad.
No matter how stumbling these two months have been, fortunately I have finally finished writing it. I would give myself an overall score of eighty-five.
As a veteran harem reader, I feel that if I were a reader, I would particularly like this book. It is the kind of book that can be read twice or three times.
Eight-character evaluation: lively, sexy, and sultry... On the premise of maintaining a high-intensity and exciting main line, every heroine is basically taken care of. Love, sex, and desire are all involved, and everything is covered.
Well, as for the writing, it's a no-brainer.
Okay, no more bragging.
Of course, there are some shortcomings and flaws. I am aware of these and will work hard to improve them in the next book.
The main text part is basically the finale. The abrupt end of the main plot is not only to leave blank space, but also to avoid procrastination. I want to use the form of postscript to explain to everyone the more interesting situations of the concubines in the harem, the vassals and the Xia Dynasty.
In this way, I don’t have the pressure to update, and I can write more calmly.
Regarding the new book, I have some ideas in mind, but because it is an urban theme, I am not sure whether I should write it or whether I should continue to delve deeper into history.
In fact, I want to change my mind. Some of me want to write about love and hatred in the moneyed city, about love in the capitalist era, about the struggles and ups and downs of crazy men and resentful women, about the complexity and change of human nature, about the intersection of joy and sorrow in life...
Of course, well, it's still a harem.
Relatively speaking, this urban theme seems to be more expressive.
Therefore, the new book is still under consideration.
Finally, I would like to thank you all for accompanying me all the way. In the past three years, more than a thousand days and nights, you have accompanied me to finish writing this book, witnessing the ups and downs of results, witnessing every climax, every update, every single chapter...every one makes you feel amazing. The amazing climax chapters are all the author's emotion and hard work. Every update that makes you feel hearty is the author's keyboard tapping from morning to night. Every single chapter that makes you feel that the author has broken the defense is the author's grievance and anger after being misunderstood and accused.
Really, several of the keyboards were broken. I replaced the mechanical keyboard with a groove in the space bar, and my fingers suffered from tenosynovitis...
Haha, stop complaining, it’s not easy for anyone.
In fact, because of his strong personalityThe hard work and the creator's stubbornness also caused some readers to leave midway. Although I regret it, I don't regret it.
Life is like writing a book. People come and go, and being together for a journey is already a fate. The fate is deep and shallow. Some people get off the car midway and never look back. Some people stay with you all the way and fully experience a dreamlike journey.
No matter how deep or shallow the fate is, you can't force it. If I can bring you a simple and happy time in our busy life, it will be the greatest value of our existence as Internet writers.
Check out the correct version one by one!
The brothers are here after all the calamities, and they forget their grudges with a smile when they meet.
I know that despite the criticism, some foul-mouthed readers still love to read my books, and they still want to read them even after being banned for fifty years, even if they are... free of charge (manual dog head).
Finally, I wish everyone a happy New Year.
I wish you all family reunion, peace and joy, abundant wealth, and all the best in the new year!
I sincerely thank my allies and lovely and respectable readers. Because of your existence, online literature can flourish today.
At the end of the day, I shamelessly ask for monthly votes again, haha, double monthly votes, please vote for me.
